g.text: Set your table — one evening, five movements
"A haven is not a place you
pass through. It is a place
No backend. No admin. No second source of truth.
hover → lift + real name, section, price
PARTY SIZE — scales real sharing formats
LIGHT RIG AS A CLOCK — the opening window
Every tier keeps the same data, the same
price math, the same checkout. Never a blank canvas.
deep green third — no utility framework
AMENDMENT A1 — OBSERVED IN THEIR OWN ASSETS
real badge + signage read teal — re-measure before M2
table.mjs — party scaling, cake formats, payload escape
all four gate tiers forced, each still checks out
M2 fast interior — Menu · Visit · Home
M3 the door — scene, rig, gate, fallback
M4 the table — math, URL, WhatsApp
M5 the clock — hour drives palette
M0–M2 ship a usable site before
